# Balay ni Bruno & Co.

> A family-built operational support studio. We run the day-to-day marketing,
> websites, content and systems for small businesses, as a long-term partner
> rather than a project vendor.

Based in the Philippines, working with clients across the United States.
Founded by RJ Bryan Tres Reyes.

## What we do

- Websites: custom-coded, Shopify and WordPress, built and maintained in-house
- Search: content built to answer the questions customers actually ask
- Social media: strategy, production and scheduling across every major platform
- Email marketing: campaigns, automated sequences and newsletters
- Content production: video, carousels, graphics and long-form writing
- Lead generation and CRM automation
- Custom AI systems built for a single business

## How we work

We do not sell projects that end. Clients get a team that stays: daily checks on the
sites we manage, one group chat with the whole team in it, and a longer call each month
for the decisions that do not belong in a chat thread.
